method: Reuse all finite frozen H1 forward outputs only after complete 114-asset byte equality and full-rule singleton checks. Compare newly executed actual JA/ZH inverse outputs to H2 final raw before outputs, matched origin/id for every row.
limitations: This is all previous finite roots, 24 suffixes and runtime-key inputs, not arbitrary infinite sentences/compounds.
Unchanged failures and changed-but-still-wrong cases remain failures and are reported separately.
Historical source IDs checked separately by every exact key plus o/ojn; two visible editions receive the full saved-word replay.
